optional-content-usage.title: Read and edit optional-content usage and usage application dictionaries
optional-content-usage.behavior: Resolve OCG Usage and configuration AS application dictionaries against their groups. Expose and modify the stored values, and verify configuration- and event-specific behavior through save/reopen.

functions-and-shadings.title: Complete PDF function, pattern and mesh shading authoring and evaluation
functions-and-shadings.behavior: Exercise sampled/calculator functions, function edits, tiling and uncolored patterns and shading types 1–7. Create and edit resources through the store, verify mesh and function evaluation independently and round-trip untouched data.

print-device-engine.title: hayro: apply output-device parameters when proofing print and screened output
print-device-engine.behavior: Apply per-object ICC intent, four-channel transfer, process and named spot plate overprint, selected halftones and scan parameters on suitable devices. RGB alternate, calibrated and transfer samples are verified.

recolour-black-generation.title: Extend active CMYK rewriting to filtered and nested budgeted PDF functions
recolour-black-generation.behavior: Evaluate filtered sampled or calculator streams, nested stitching and calculator procedures with released construction and execution budgets.

optional-content-engine.title: hayro: evaluate optional content visibility expressions and annotation /OC
optional-content-engine.behavior: Adopt engine evaluation of visibility expressions and annotation OC. Track the upstream issue directly. #373 owns local adoption.

transparency.title: Complete transparency group, soft-mask and compositing coverage
transparency.behavior: Exercise non-isolated and knockout groups, group masks, blending colour spaces, alpha composition and Annex Q resource traversal. Verify isolated and nested results with independent rendered references.

annotation-appearances.title: Write rollover/down and widget icon appearances and line or popup annotation details
annotation-appearances.behavior: Implement rollover/down streams, widget MK icons and IF fitting, line captions and leaders, and popup parent semantics. Check independent rendering and relationships after edit/reopen.

redaction-marks.title: Write rollover/down and widget icon appearances and line or popup annotation details
redaction-marks.behavior: Inspect and edit stored redaction marks, overlay text and appearance streams. Preserve the marks through reopening before destructive application.

font-programs.title: Complete font program, encoding and CMap creation and editing
font-programs.behavior: Round-trip font resources with Type 1/custom fonts, Differences and embedded code-to-CID maps. Cover TrueType and Type 3 changes, standard character tables and preservation of text and glyph placement.

devicen-mixing-hints.title: hayro: offer DeviceN mixing hints to colour-proofing devices
devicen-mixing-hints.behavior: Offer the stored solidities, printing order and dot-gain functions to devices that opt into colourant-based proofing. Alternate RGB conversion and directly addressed process and spot plates are independently checked.

text-fields-and-xfa.title: Support rich variable text, password appearances and legacy XFA form data
text-fields-and-xfa.behavior: Read and edit RV/DS field data, mask displayed password glyphs, and inspect, edit/remove and preserve existing XFA packets under the recorded creation exclusion. Verify field values and appearances independently.

image-resources.title: Support alternate image resources, masks and reference XObjects through rewriting
image-resources.behavior: Read and rewrite image alternates, masks and reference XObject relationships, verifying selection, unchanged resource bytes, and output without fetching or executing external content.

redaction.title: Redaction: remove text, images, and vector content under redaction annotations
redaction.behavior: Apply and verify redaction annotations over text, paths and images, using item provenance for destructive removal.

name-tree-navigation.title: Resolve catalog name trees, structure destinations and viewer action parameters
name-tree-navigation.behavior: Follow named resources and structure destinations, resolve base URI/IsMap, Windows launch and remote/named targets as data, and round-trip fragment selection and navigation options. Expose unresolved targets without executing actions.

tagged-authoring.title: Author standard tagged attributes, class maps and legal structure children
tagged-authoring.behavior: Author and edit class maps, object references, user properties and standard structure attributes. Validate child multiplicities and relationships through page operations and independent checks.

aes-gcm.title: Read and write AES-GCM encrypted PDFs under ISO/TS 32003
aes-gcm.behavior: Read and write authenticated AES-GCM objects with independent positive and negative cases.

hash-signature-extensions.title: Complete the PDF hash and signature algorithm coverage for ISO/TS 32001 and 32002
hash-signature-extensions.behavior: Verify and create each specified hash/signature algorithm against independent vectors, including Ed25519 and Ed448.

integrity-protection.title: Verify and maintain document integrity protection for encrypted PDFs under ISO/TS 32004
integrity-protection.behavior: Verify and maintain integrity protection during encrypted saves and refuse tampered data.

public-key-encryption.title: Extend CMS algorithm coverage for public-key PDF recipients
public-key-encryption.behavior: Verify and extend additional CMS provider algorithms for recipient access, creation, editing and preservation.

public-key-legacy-interpretation.title: Render legacy recipient-encrypted PDFs through the authenticated store source
public-key-legacy-interpretation.behavior: Render authenticated pre-V5 recipient files through the engine object-source interface.

indirect-stream-filter-selection.title: Resolve indirect stream filter selectors and parameters in their document revision
indirect-stream-filter-selection.behavior: Resolve filter names and parameter references in the correct revision before reading or creating encrypted streams, and retain their reference identities through saves.

crypt-filter-payload-edits.title: Keep stream crypt-filter selection when replacing attachment or stream data
crypt-filter-payload-edits.behavior: Retain the leading security filter and its parameters when replacing the decoded payload or compression, including an attachment restricted to a distinct recipient audience.

signature-dictionaries.title: Resolve signature seed constraints and build properties through signing and editing
signature-dictionaries.behavior: Read, enforce and round-trip seed-value and field lock constraints when signing. Exercise Prop_Build dictionaries, hand-built and existing unsigned fields and independent signature verification.

crypt-filter-rendering.title: Render explicit legacy crypt filters and independently keyed recipient streams from the store
crypt-filter-rendering.behavior: Interpret explicit legacy password filters and an independently keyed page stream through the authenticated version, including correct refusal for an unauthorized page.

stream-filters.title: Complete stream filter read, rewrite and preservation cases
stream-filters.behavior: Round-trip encoded and decoded streams across the listed filter chains and parameters. Cover ASCIIHex re-encoding, Group 3 fax and JPX output gaps, and retain untouched encoded data. Account for unsupported encoder paths explicitly.

tagged-reading.title: Interpret standard structure roles, children, and abbreviation expansion in document order
tagged-reading.behavior: Walk standard/custom roles and parent-child multiplicities, order content using structure references and expose abbreviation expansion in extracted output. Compare with hand-verified tagged documents.

accessible-archival-authoring.title: Create accessible archival PDFs from a new Document through the public API
accessible-archival-authoring.behavior: Create an accessible archival document with a valid claim and have an independent validator verify the result.

early-profile-authoring.title: Broaden the PDF/A and PDF/UA claim-reading and authoring matrix by flavour
early-profile-authoring.behavior: Create and independently validate the earlier PDF/A and PDF/UA profile examples.

pdf-profile-corpus.title: Broaden the PDF/A and PDF/UA claim-reading and authoring matrix by flavour
pdf-profile-corpus.behavior: Exercise independently sourced conforming and negative fixtures beyond the original vector example. Validate public authoring per listed part and level using independent validation and retain allowable source variations.

pdf-profile-reading.title: Broaden the PDF/A and PDF/UA claim-reading and authoring matrix by flavour
pdf-profile-reading.behavior: Exercise additional conforming and negative sources beyond the original per-flavour vector example.

print-profiles.title: Validate PDF/X and PDF/VT profile rules through a print exchange round trip
print-profiles.behavior: Read and write production profile metadata and output intents, edit a conforming job and verify the claim with an independent validator and negative control. Cover PDF/VT document parts and the declared PDF/X flavour.

profile-edit-effects.title: Verify profile edit effects on nested resources and alternate structure encodings
profile-edit-effects.behavior: Extend the checked edit matrix to nested resources, alternate structure relationships, and font representations with positive and negative controls.

interchange.title: Expose developer extensions, associated files, page-piece dictionaries, document parts, and structure namespaces
interchange.behavior: Expose and edit extension, associated-file, page-piece, document-part and namespace relationships through bounded store operations.

3d-scene-settings.title: Author 3D scene settings and dimensional measurements as PDF data
3d-scene-settings.behavior: Resolve scene, camera and activation settings and each dimensional measurement geometry. Verify view, stream and measurement references after editing.

prepress.title: Complete prepress dictionaries and print annotation relationships
prepress.behavior: Resolve box colour, separations, trapping, OPI and print annotation relationships and preserve or edit them under the edition policy.

richmedia-extensions.title: Support STEP and glTF assets in RichMedia annotations under the published PDF 2.0 extensions
richmedia-extensions.behavior: Read, author and verify STEP and glTF asset relationships against the published extensions.

web-capture.title: Read, edit and preserve Web Capture content sets and their indexes
web-capture.behavior: Read, edit and round-trip captured content sets and their indexes.

inventory.changes: The preceding map had no dated provision or correction inventory. This review adds the edition's numbered contents and annexes, the published STEP and glTF extensions, profile parts and corrigenda, and the technical group's correction register. It distinguishes geographic coordinates (12.10) from processor requirements (12.11) and updates the references for interactive form dictionaries (12.7.3) and collection navigators (12.3.5.3, correction 477).
inventory.grouping: The base crosswalk follows the published contents through the second-level clauses. Descendant provisions use the listed feature IDs, with individual rows for specialized behaviors and correction locations. Empty feature lists document introductory or informative material. Every linked feature has the five map dimensions; a link supplies no implementation evidence.
inventory.watchlist: The base amendment (DAmd 1.2), revisions of 32004, 32005 and PDF/A-4, the PDF/UA-1 amendment, 32008 and 32009 stay on the publication watchlist in #258.
inventory.review: Within one month of publication, compare the official catalogues and the PDF Association correction register with this snapshot. Diff the published pages between pins as well as comparing their identifiers, because wording can change at an existing location. Record the changed publication, provision, correction ID, affected features and dimensions. Add a regression test for the corrected behavior or link an open implementation issue from #258 that names the correction and the missing test. Preserve the release exclusions, record the delta from the previous pin, regenerate both outputs and run the offline checks.
